scenarios.name: creature-is-shuffled-in-and-a-permanent-top-comes-back
scenarios.why: The owner of the target permanent shuffles it into their library, then reveals the top card. This scenario's opponent library is all permanents (Wastes lands), so whatever is revealed is a permanent card and enters the battlefield under its owner. The shuffled-in Grizzly Bears is in the library; a Wastes now sits on the battlefield.
